created_purpose: Generate music videos whose visuals demonstrably teach one stated causal claim, via a structured intent-card and shot-list pipeline rather than freeform AI clip assembly.
non_goals_now: Do not claim a generated video is production-ready without the stage-6 comprehension gate passing.
Do not treat subsystem names carried over from the originating design conversation as implemented until independently re-derived and evidenced.
Do not skip the stage-1 maxim gate.
Do not attempt single-shot quality and cross-shot continuity in the same build pass.

next_3_plus_1.next_2: Write the Shot List JSON schema (stage 3), including the coverage-set (5 angles x 2 takes) field.
next_3_plus_1.next_3: Prototype the stage-4 continuity subsystem (SAM 2 + depth-conditioned generation) for one tracked object across two states.
